name: Wood and Leaf
summary: Gather ash logs and riverleaf from Millrace Fields.
startText: The ovens need ash and the broth needs riverleaf. Pim sells a hatchet; riverleaf you can pick by hand along the millrace. Ten logs, eight leaves.
inProgressText: Ten ash logs and eight riverleaf from the fields.
completionText: That will keep the fires going. Take the broth.
